alt: Every ingredient in the Sensitive Skin Set. The Pure Unscented Body Lotion has 6: purified spring water, organic virgin coconut oil, organic jojoba, organic plant-based emulsifying wax, organic grapefruit seed extract, organic red palm oil. The Pure Unscented Body Cream has 7: purified spring water, organic virgin coconut oil, organic plant-based emulsifying wax, organic palm stearic, organic grapefruit seed extract, organic beeswax, organic red palm oil. No fragrance, parfum or essential oils appear in either.
